meta.title: Projects — Australia Construction Consultants & Associates
meta.description: The shape of the engagements ACCA takes on. Illustrative examples — specific project references available under NDA on request.

intro.headline: The shape of the work.
intro.lede: Illustrative examples of the kinds of engagements ACCA takes on. Specific project references, with clients and outcomes, are available under NDA on request.

items.problem: A developer needs a project manager to run a mid-rise apartment build on their behalf from tender award through practical completion — sitting on the owner's side of the table.
items.intervention: End-to-end PM engagement: consultant coordination, principal reporting, cost and programme tracking, monthly board packs, and contract administration under AS 4902.
items.outcome_label: Owner-representative role from award to handover.

items.problem: A principal takes on a health-sector build under AS 4000 and needs contract advisory support — RFIs, variations, and EOT assessments — during the critical delivery phase.
items.intervention: Contract administration during construction: RFI register, variation register, monthly progress claims and certifications, EOT windows analysis where claims are served.

items.problem: A school board is weighing a stage-two build and needs an independent read on cost, programme, and risk before authorising tender.
items.intervention: Feasibility study to elemental cost-plan level. Benchmarked against comparable completed projects; risk register issued alongside the cost plan.
items.outcome_label: Board-ready feasibility with cost plan and risk register.

items.problem: An owner needs an independent trade-level estimate to test a builder's lump-sum price on a multi-tenancy industrial build before award.
items.intervention: Trade-level estimate with rate build-ups; benchmarking against comparable completed projects; written commentary on the drivers of the difference to the tendered price.
items.outcome_label: Independent cost check ahead of award.

items.problem: A principal on a precinct-scale infrastructure project needs certainty that construction matches the approved design and satisfies each authority condition before handover.
items.intervention: Design-stage compliance review, construction-stage audits against NCC and planning conditions, and a close-out schedule of non-conformances tracked to resolution.
items.outcome_label: Documented compliance close-out against each authority condition.

items.problem: An owner wants an independent set of eyes on quality and risk during a retail fit-out — separate from the builder's own QA — with monthly audits and a live risk register.
items.intervention: Project risk register established and maintained live; ITP audits on defined milestones; non-conformance tracking with recommended actions.
items.outcome_label: Live risk register and independent quality audits through construction.
